Hi Kajal, welcome! It's great to meet you. Thanks for taking the time to interview with us today.  I've reviewed your resume and I'm impressed with your projects, especially the Java-based inventory management system and the web-based expense tracker.  They demonstrate a good understanding of several key technologies.

To get started, could you please tell me a little about yourself, your background, and what aspects of software development most interest you?  I'm particularly keen to hear more about your experiences and what motivates you.

Kajal, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today.  I've truly appreciated learning more about your experience and skills;  your insights have been invaluable.  The team will now review all applications, and we'll be in touch within [ timeframe, e.g., one week ] to let you know the next steps in the hiring process.  Thank you again, and have a wonderful day.
